task_description: PR83 corrected opt-in Graph-Qwen FLOW on the same 128 product-only FlowER validation IDs as the frozen pure-Qwen baseline. Qwen generates IMPORT to EOS in one greedy call and stops FLOW after the tool name; only graph arguments replace FLOW. New single-pass contract forbids resuming the previous two-pass run. Accepted-flow depth, non-oracle four-event budget, 40 decisions, 32 imports, 4096 context and 384 Qwen tokens/call. Full trajectories, default POD stdout and 60-second heartbeat. This config is prepared but must not be started while the user-requested GPU stop remains in effect.
